messages:
junaid_csm: Quick heads-up — Sablefield onboarding: their activation traffic spiked this morning and we see a 15–20% P95 token latency regression vs last week. Renew timeline in 6 weeks, so this is a proactive nudge.

maria_cs: ugh. any single-source root yet? logs/dash look correlated to longer prompts + sudden throughput spikes.

ajenkins: can you paste the dashboard link and a sample tail trace? runbook says start with quantization pilot + routing tweak for mixed traffic.

junaid_csm: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/sablefield/perf — sample trace: "req=2023-06-12T10:02Z p95=420ms tokens=620 model=redwood-v2-8b". Hypothesis: KV cache hit rate dropped during bursts; bigger prompts + batch pressure.

sam_devops: I can run a quick A/B with Int8 compact on a small canary (5% traffic). Suggest flow: 1) create canary model slot (int8-8b) 2) route 5% traffic by route rule 3) monitor latency + hallucination metrics for 6h.

leo_infra: +1. Also recommend adding a fallback rule to original model if latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive minutes. We should also enable per-request prefix caching for their most common prompt templates.

maria_cs: client-facing note: we should propose savings estimate and a QA window. They care about cost but will not accept quality regressions. Can we quantify expected cost delta?

ajenkins: rough numbers: int8 -> ~30% vCPU/gpu token cost reduction on this workload. If latency holds or improves we can propose a staged swap. I'll draft the rollout steps.

sam_devops: config snippet for canary routing: \n```\nroute: /v1/generate\ncanary: true\ntraffic_split:\n  - model: redwood-v2-8b-int8\n    weight: 0.05\n  - model: redwood-v2-8b\n    weight: 0.95\nfallback_policy:\n  - condition: latency>600ms for 180s\n    action: route to redwood-v2-8b\nmetrics: [p50,p95,token_error_rate,semantic-accuracy]\n```\n
leo_infra: add KV cache policy: prefix_keys: ["sablefield:q1_template","sablefield:q2_template"] TTL=12h. That should raise effective cache hit and drop tail latency for repeated prompts.

maria_cs: good. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with Sablefield CSM + PM tomorrow 11am PT to get buy-in. Can we have a short blurb and expected SLA impact for the call?

ajenkins: I'll write a 2-slide brief: what we change, rollout plan, rollback criteria, expected cost delta (-~30% if successful) and safety gates.

deploy_bot: deploy_started: canary-slot redwood-v2-8b-int8 -> infra-canary-5pct at 4890012405

sam_devops: thanks — I'll watch traces and post the first 30m summary in this thread. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: killer — capture client feedback during QA, esp around subtle generation quality. If they flag anything, we pause the canary and pull logs.

junaid_csm: summary: canary int8 @5%, KV prefix caching + fallback rule. Sync w/ client 11am PT. Owners: ajenkins (rollout doc), sam_devops (monitoring), maria_cs (client comms). Will post post-mortem/metrics in 24h.

sam_devops: 30m update: p95 dropped from 420ms -> 365ms for canary, token_error_rate unchanged, semantic-accuracy stable on 1k eval prompts. Continuing monitoring.

maria_cs: perfecto. I'll prep the client note and flag renewal playbook owners. :white_check_mark:
